description.purpose: The seed hive of hard-shell. It draws NO edge: the door, the terminal and every lane arrive through grow.json. The one thing checked in beside it is the cell the whole example is about -- an outbound HTTP client, configured with nothing.
description.use_when: As the --root of a colony you are going to attack on purpose.
description.not_in_scope: No agent, no model, no key, no memory. This colony answers no questions; it only reaches outwards, and the point is where it refuses to.
